description: The Limuru Tea Company Limited is a Kenyan company engaged in the growing of green leaf tea. The Company owns 275 hectares of tea land situated four kilometers to the east of Limuru Town. The Limuru Tea Company Limited is an outgrower to Unilever Tea Kenya Limited. Unilever Tea Kenya acts as the Company's managing agent in the growing, manufacturing, sales and marketing of its teas. The tea estate green leaf is manufactured in the Unilever Tea Kenya Mabroukie factory from where it is sold mainly for export.
address: Nakuru-Kericho Highway, PO Box 20-20200, Kericho, Kenya
